limitations.inference: Descriptive sensitivity only; no p-values, statistical significance, semantic-understanding claims or personality scores.
limitations.sampling: Small planned n=4 per probe actor; four of eight cyclic positions is partial counterbalancing, not randomization or a complete Latin balance.
limitations.identityEffects: Persona IDs/names are also model input; paired labels and inferred knowledge are possible effects, not isolated human causal traits.
limitations.distribution: Normalized model probabilities are separate from observed selected-action frequencies. TV uses matching candidate keysets within matching initial/config/mapping groups; invalid and missing observations are not zero-filled.
limitations.routes: Visible labels can merge sidebar and main-card actions. Exact selected candidate IDs and mappings are retained separately; merged labels do not prove identical routes.
limitations.native: Native conditions and reasons are model self-reports, not verified understanding; identical images do not imply identical generated criteria or complete action inputs.
limitations.censoring: A valid cap-1 DECISION_LIMIT selection is harness-censored, not user completion or abandonment. Flow and failed prefixes are reported separately.
